content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Peoria

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hours and years of hands-on experience required, then document your background. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you assess whether your qualifications align with PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our expert instructors deliver intensive, interactive sessions covering the PMBOK Guide and real-world project scenarios. You'll earn the 35 contact hours required by PMI to sit for the exam—all on a schedule that fits working professionals.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your formal education, file your PMP application directly with PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Our team will guide you through the submission process to ensure all documentation is complete and accurate. PMI will review and approve your application before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's targeted exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and review sessions—to build confidence before test day. Our instructors remain available to address your questions. When you're ready, register with Pearson VUE and sit for the computer-based PMP exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn continuing professional education units (PDUs) throughout your three-year certification cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers multiple pathways to accumulate PDUs, from advanced courses to mentoring and conference attendance. Plan your renewal strategy early to stay current with PMI requirements.
